title: The man who made his own sound
subject: William Onyeabor
context: A Nigerian musician whose distinctive electronic funk combines expansive grooves and synthesizers. His independently released recordings later found new audiences through international reissues.

sources.label: Luaka Bop: William Onyeabor (official artist page)

Biographical stories about him are unverified (NPR); the copy avoids them.
